Day 1 — Langdale HorseshoeDay 2 — Amphibious Adventure

Day 1 — Langdale Horseshoe

A high-level Langdale Horseshoe starting and finishing near Old Dungeon Ghyll in Great Langdale. The route climbs into the Langdale Pikes area, reaches the rocky tops of Bowfell and Crinkle Crags, then drops back to the valley floor.

19.4 kmGPX distance
~1,460 mCumulative GPX ascent
892 mHighest GPX point
Old Dungeon GhyllStart and finish vicinity

From valley to ridge and back

  1. Old Dungeon Ghyll to Thunacar Knott. The loop first heads east along the foot of the fells, then climbs onto the high ground around the Langdale Pikes and Thunacar Knott.
  2. Stake Pass to the Esk Hause area. The line swings west across the head of Mickleden and climbs towards the high passes west of the valley.
  3. Bowfell and Crinkle Crags. The GPX turns south-east onto the Bowfell ridge, then goes over Three Tarns and the broken rocky ground of Crinkle Crags.
  4. Pike o’ Blisco and the valley. The route heads east via the Red Tarn area and Pike o’ Blisco before dropping back to Old Dungeon Ghyll.

The interactive map needs an internet connection.

The line follows the supplied GPX. Elevations are from the file and may differ from published summit heights.

Winter on the high fells
Check the mountain forecast and daylight before heading out. Snow and ice can make the rocky ridge hazardous. Choose a lower route if conditions exceed the group’s winter skills or equipment.

Day 2 — Amphibious Adventure: Lingmoor Fell and Brathay Packrafting

A point-to-point adventure beginning at New Dungeon Ghyll, climbing Lingmoor Fell, descending to Skelwith Bridge and aiming to reach the northern end of Windermere by packraft before exploring Waterhead and Ambleside.

469 mLingmoor Fell summit
~6 kmIndicative river corridor; not measured GPX
2–3Published grade of key downstream rapid
516Bus route towards Great Langdale; verify service
⚠️ Critical equipment limit
Your Decathlon packraft is not certified above Grade 2. A published Grade 2–3 rapid before Brathay Pool prevents treating Skelwith Bridge → Windermere as a continuous approved descent. A safe upstream exit, portage and re-entry have NOT been verified. Do not launch on the assumption that you can bypass it.

Day plan

The proposed Day 2 itinerary

Times are illustrative, not a promise that the river is passable. Do not set a train deadline that pressures you into continuing on unsuitable water.

06:15
New Dungeon Ghyll — Begin mountain run with packed raft.
08:15
Lingmoor Fell — Summit, weather and daylight check.
09:30
Elterwater — Descend towards Skelwith Bridge.
10:30
Skelwith Bridge — Scout launch, flow, exits and obstacles. Do not launch without a safe exit confirmed before the Grade 2–3 rapid.
Flexible
River / alternative transfer — Paddle only independently assessed suitable sections; otherwise travel overland to Waterhead.
Later
Windermere & Ambleside — Explore northern lakeshore and village, conditions permitting.
Return
Bus 516 — Check the actual date's timetable and direction before departure.
Before entering the water

Go / no-go gates

✓ Only launch if

River level and current conditions are suitable; all hazards have been assessed; a lawful safe exit before the Grade 2–3 rapid is confirmed; the group has the necessary skills, equipment and rescue arrangements.

Mandatory checks

✕ Abort if

The rapid cannot be safely avoided, the bank is inaccessible, trees obstruct the channel, water is high, daylight is insufficient, or Windermere is too windy or exposed for your boat.
